items.title: Better Business Bureau warns of surge in AI-powered loan scams as consumer losses climb
items.why: Fraud-driven loan losses could push issuers and lenders to tighten fraud controls and identity checks.
items.summary_ai: The Better Business Bureau warns that AI-powered loan scams are rising and consumer losses are climbing.
items.take: Fraud-driven loan losses could push issuers and lenders to tighten fraud controls and identity checks.
